Class BattleController

java.lang.Object
gamemode.fightscene.BattleController
public class BattleController extends Object
Controls the turn-based battle logic between the player (P'Tae) and an enemy Dinosaur.

This class wires up all four combat actions available in CommandBox (Fight, Bag, Catch, Escape) and manages the turn order, win/loss conditions, and post-battle transitions.

Turn flow

  Player presses action
      │
      ├─ FIGHT  → deal damage → enemy dead? → victory
      │                       → still alive → enemy turn → player dead? → defeat
      │                                                   → still alive → player turn
      ├─ BAG    → use potion → stay on player turn (enemy does not counter)
      ├─ CATCH  → HP ≤ 10%? → consume DinoBall → add TamedDinosaur → caught
      │         → HP > 10%? → message, stay on player turn
      └─ ESCAPE → immediately end battle, return to world

Guards

  • All actions are silently ignored when battleEnded is true.
  • Fight and Catch are silently ignored when it is not the player's turn (playerTurn == false).

  • Constructor Details

    • BattleController

      public BattleController(CommandBox commandBox, BattleView view, Dinosaur enemy)
      Constructs a BattleController and registers all four action handlers on the provided CommandBox. Registered handlers
      • Fight — opens a weapon selection sub-menu, deals damage, and triggers the enemy turn (or victory) after a 1-second pause.
      • Bag — opens a potion selection sub-menu and applies the chosen potion immediately. The enemy does not counter after a potion.
      • Catch — delegates to catchDinosaur().
      • Escape — ends the battle immediately and calls BattleView.onEscape().
      Parameters:
      commandBox - the UI panel whose buttons will be wired to combat actions
      view - the battle scene view for HP updates and scene transitions
      enemy - the enemy dinosaur the player is fighting
